user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and search answers.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and compliance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content used for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used to train generative AI foundation models.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions initiated by user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web page visits and external application interactions via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for AI model development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow ClaudeBot in robots.txt to exclude future materials from training datasets.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites at users' direction to answer Claude AI user questions.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user-initiated requests in response to user queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-User in robots.txt to prevent retrieval in user search.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to enhance search result quality and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed for user search optimization and accuracy.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt to prevent indexing for search optimization.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes and performing product-specific crawls.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, Google News, and other search features.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Find images for Google search indexes and features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search image presentations.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video-related content.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Test pages using Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for product teams fetching publicly accessible content and internal R&D.
user_agents.scope: Internal research and development and various product teams without affecting specific products.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Optimized image fetching for internal R&D and various product teams.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Optimized video fetching for internal R&D and various product teams.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Perform site-owner requested crawls for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control training Gemini models and grounding for Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.scope: Gemini model training and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index web information to deliver search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index web information operating in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers Apple search technology and trains foundation models for generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and rendering for Apple search features and generative AI training data.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled content for training Apple's generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl; determines usage of Applebot crawled data for generative AI training.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts; does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps such as Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information including title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; might bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to cite and link to content in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for advertising and business-related products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Used for training foundation AI models and improving products by indexing content.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches user-requested links and helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by users.

user_agents.name: bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to power Bing search and Microsoft AI features.
user_agents.scope: Web content indexing for Bing search engine and Microsoft Copilot.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates page snapshots and previews for search results.
user_agents.scope: Page snapshots for Bing search and services.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls host-level web pages to improve Amazon products and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives and robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives or robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information to answer user queries.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated live web requests on the user's behalf; does not train generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler providing open data copy of the Internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Crawls a sample of the web using HTTP GET requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: CCBot or opt-out registry.
